title: For ports that are DOWN and are also bound to the security group ID <code>0
question: For ports that are DOWN and are also bound to the security group ID 0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c, show the port ID, tenant ID, MAC address, port status, and allocated IP address, along with (1) the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each security group (ordered by standard attribute ID) and (2) the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each network (ordered by standard attribute ID). Additionally, for each tenant appearing in these results, include the total number of ports they own and the average number of ports across all tenants. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.id AS port_id,
         p.tenant_id,
         p.mac_address,
         p.status AS port_status,
         p.network_id,
         p.standard_attr_id,
         sgpb.security_group_id,
         ia.ip_address AS allocated_ip_address
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
    AND sgpb.security_group_id = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c'
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT port_id,
         tenant_id,
         mac_address,
         port_status,
         allocated_ip_address,
         standard_attr_id,
         SUM(standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY security_group_id ORDER BY standard_attr_id) AS running_sum_security_group,
         SUM(standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY network_id ORDER BY standard_attr_id) AS running_sum_network
  FROM base
),
tenant_port_counts AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS total_ports_for_tenant
  FROM base
  GROUP BY tenant_id
),
avg_tenant_counts AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_ports_for_tenant) AS avg_ports_across_tenants
  FROM tenant_port_counts
)
SELECT w.port_id,
       w.tenant_id,
       w.mac_address,
       w.port_status,
       w.allocated_ip_address,
       w.running_sum_security_group,
       w.running_sum_network,
       tc.total_ports_for_tenant,
       atc.avg_ports_across_tenants
FROM windowed w
JOIN tenant_port_counts tc ON tc.tenant_id = w.tenant_id
CROSS JOIN avg_tenant_counts atc
ORDER BY w.standard_attr_id

Output fields: port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, port_status, allocated_ip_address, running_sum_security_group, running_sum_network, total_ports_for_tenant, avg_ports_across_tenants are all present in the correct order.
No rounding is applied; the average is returned as a decimal (2.0000) as observed in execution.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, p.status, ia.ip_address,
         b.security_group_id, p.network_id, p.standard_attr_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings b ON b.port_id = p.id
  LEFT JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
    AND b.security_group_id = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c'
),
with_sums AS (
  SELECT base.*,
         SUM(standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY security_group_id ORDER BY standard_attr_id) AS sg_running_sum,
         SUM(standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY network_id ORDER BY standard_attr_id) AS net_running_sum
  FROM base
),
tenant_counts AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) AS tenant_port_count
  FROM base
  GROUP BY tenant_id
)
SELECT w.id, w.tenant_id, w.mac_address, w.status, w.ip_address,
       w.sg_running_sum, w.net_running_sum,
       tc.tenant_port_count,
       AVG(tc.tenant_port_count) OVER () AS avg_ports_across_tenants
FROM with_sums w
JOIN tenant_counts tc ON tc.tenant_id = w.tenant_id
ORDER BY w.standard_attr_id;

WITH base_ports AS (
  SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, p.status,
         p.standard_attr_id, p.network_id, sgpb.security_group_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON p.id = sgpb.port_id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
    AND sgpb.security_group_id = '0008e629-5619-41e0-b86c-4eecfeaacb6c'
),
windowed AS (
  SELECT port_id, tenant_id, mac_address, status,
         SUM(standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY security_group_id ORDER BY standard_attr_id) AS running_sum_security_group,
         SUM(standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY network_id ORDER BY standard_attr_id) AS running_sum_network
  FROM base_ports
),
tenant_counts AS (
  SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(id) AS total_ports_for_tenant
  FROM ports
  GROUP BY tenant_id
),
avg_tenant_counts AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_ports_for_tenant) AS avg_ports_across_tenants
  FROM tenant_counts
)
SELECT w.port_id, w.tenant_id, w.mac_address, w.status AS port_status,
       ia.ip_address AS allocated_ip_address,
       w.running_sum_security_group, w.running_sum_network,
       tc.total_ports_for_tenant, atc.avg_ports_across_tenants
FROM windowed w
LEFT JOIN ipallocations ia ON ia.port_id = w.port_id
JOIN tenant_counts tc ON w.tenant_id = tc.tenant_id
CROSS JOIN avg_tenant_counts atc
